scenes.headline: How an agent tunes its own harness
scenes.sub: And what thirty tasks can and cannot say about it.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cobnut! LobeHub let its agent spend a week rewriting its own harness. Here is how that loop works, and how to read its score.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Freeze the model, record every step the agent takes, and let an agent rewrite the loop around the model from those records.
scenes.mark: rewrite the loop around the model
scenes.say: The weights never change. The harness does: prompts, tools, context and recovery, rewritten by an agent reading its own traces.

steps.say: Every run is recorded step by step: each model call, each tool, its tokens, where it failed.
An improver agent reads the failed traces in bulk and groups the errors.
It proposes a change to the harness: a prompt, a tool schema, a context rule.
The new harness is scored on tasks, and the edit is kept or dropped. Which tasks decides what the score means.

scenes.title: How the benchmark keeps it fair
scenes.say: The benchmark was built to compare harnesses, not models.

items.say: Every harness runs the same model.
Thirty tasks, each checked by a verifier.
Every run starts from a fresh checkpoint.
And one attempt per task, because keeping the best attempt inflates the score.

steps.say: LobeHub's harness passed twenty-one of thirty, at a dollar sixty-eight per success.
The footnote matters: one selected trial per task.

scenes.title: Best of N, average baseline
scenes.note: Expected passes if an average baseline keeps its best attempt
scenes.say: Selection alone moves the score. An average harness passes about seventeen in one try, and about twenty-two keeping the best of three.

scenes.title: Why the cache sets the bill

parts.note: fresh input, ten times the price
parts.say: Input tokens that miss the cache cost three dollars a million.
Cached tokens cost thirty cents. The misses drive the bill.

scenes.text: A harness search is judged by held-out tasks, one attempt each, with every attempt billed.
scenes.say: Score a harness search on tasks the loop never saw, one attempt each, with every attempt billed.

recap: Thirty tasks cannot rank close harnesses
Retries and cache move the cost
scenes.say: An agent can tune its own harness. Thirty tasks can't rank it, and retries and cache hits move its cost.
